item.title: Tyres were fly tipped behind our garden fence near to the rail line, 4th August
item.description:
Sunday evening tyres were fly tipped from the Sidcup station car park over the fence behind our back garden fence. I was outside when this was happening and tried to take a video of their van as they drove away but unfortunately it was quite grainy and I'm unsure if they had their number plate hidden. However I can tell you that the time of this was 8.48pm on Sunday evening so hopefully the station has cctv which you could use to identify the vehicle.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Greenwood Close, Blackfen, Greater London
